svg.title: Codex Micro complete keyboard wiring, black and white, expanded top-down view
svg.text: The entire keyboard, wire by wire
Expanded top-down view. Key positions match the front of the keyboard; hidden contacts are exposed as labeled insets.
All wires are black here; follow labels, not insulation color.
Tabs at bottom. Four gold pads at right.
Front layout, USB / back of keyboard at the top. Wire contacts underneath.
One wide Voice cap, two switches / two diodes
Every switch: column wire > switch > diode > row wire.
All 13 diodes are 1N4148. The black band faces the row wire.
Key legs are symbolic here; either switch terminal can be the column.
Used holes A-K / 03-12; enlarged on sheet 2
Underside pads: 0-5 at Agent 01-06; 6-13 at case
Knob push ground > perfboard A3 > A4 > B4 > KB G
Unplug USB before soldering. Keep RAW jumper open. Use the firmware brightness limit (15%).
Matches the website firmware and bench perfboard map. Component positions are spread out for clarity; this is not a case-fit drawing or confirmation of your soldered build.
